The buzz never left. Bookmark this page for the latest news, rumblings and analysis from ESPN's insiders.</description><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 20:34:09 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2025/0121/r1441247_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Athletes are just as hyped for 'Grand Theft Auto VI' as everyone else</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50531977/gta-vi-grand-theft-auto-athletes</link><description>The latest entry in the Grand Theft Auto series is tied with "The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time" with a 99 rating on Metacritic.</description><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 19:58:50 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2025/0506/r1488856_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Timberwolves' Edwards has 'no clue' on when he will return</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50532808/timberwolves-edwards-no-clue-return</link><description>Timberwolves guard Anthony Edwards said he has "no clue" when he will return to play from right knee surgery weeks ago, but was optimistic about his long-term prognosis.</description><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 19:14:28 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/0101/r1595435_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>Thursday's fantasy hoops adds, NBA bets to make: Spencer, Champagnie worth playing</title><link>https://www.espn.com/fantasy/basketball/story/_/id/50446164/fantasy-basketball-tips-nba-betting-picks-today</link><description>Eric Moody breaks down Thursday's NBA slate, highlighting the fantasy streamers to add and his favorite bets.</description><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 17:21:45 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1119/r1748145_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
